billing.task: Implement summarize_records and revenue_report in billing.py and component tests.

booking.task: Build customer booking flow; own booking.py and new component tests.

delivery.task: Implement delivery management; own delivery.py and new component tests.

notifications.task: Implement customer notifications; own notifications.py and new component tests.

events.author: notifications
events.body: Implement existing confirmation(email: str, delivery_id: int) -> str. Validate email as a nonempty ASCII mailbox with one @, no whitespace/control characters, dotted DNS domain; delivery_id must be positive int excluding bool. Invalid values raise ValueError. Return 'Delivery {delivery_id} is confirmed. Confirmation for {email}.' No delivery lookup, outbound email, money amounts or refund calculation. /notify caller remains unchanged. Please agree to this exact revision or propose needed compatibility changes.

events.author: billing
events.body: Propose exact public boundary: delivery.get_delivery_records() returns list[dict], [] when empty; each record has integer total_cents and refund_cents, and status ('confirmed' or 'cancelled'). Billing iterates records directly, sums total_cents - refund_cents for every saved record, and counts each status. revenue_report() returns {'revenue_cents': int, 'confirmed': int, 'cancelled': int}. Please agree or propose revised shape before interface integration.

events.author: booking
events.body: Proposed revision 1: booking_request(total_cents: int, customer: str, destination: str) -> dict with exactly total_cents/customer/destination for create_delivery(**request). Reject bool/non-int total_cents with TypeError, negative cents with ValueError (zero allowed); require nonempty stripped strings for customer/destination, reject non-string with TypeError and blank with ValueError, return stripped text. Browser POST /book with those fields; POST /cancel with delivery_id; render returned delivery_id, status, total_cents, refund_cents without computing refund policy. Please agree or propose changes.

events.author: booking
events.body: TASK.md human requirements: cancellation persists a full refund; booking browser displays returned server amounts and does not calculate refund policy.
events.source:
Cancellation saves refund_cents equal to total_cents.
Billing counts actual saved refunds; a fully refunded delivery contributes zero revenue.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Revision 2: preserve starter public boundary and baseline: get_delivery_records() -> dict[int, dict], {} when empty, copied snapshots keyed by positive delivery ID. Iterate .values(). Each record has delivery_id: positive int, total_cents: nonnegative int, customer: str, destination: str, status: confirmed|cancelled, refund_cents: nonnegative int (0 initially, total_cents after cancellation). Billing sums saved total_cents - refund_cents and counts statuses; revenue_report -> {revenue_cents:int, confirmed:int, cancelled:int}. create/get/cancel return copied records. Please agree to revision 2.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Agreed booking-request revision 1. Actual delivery create/get/cancel records will use delivery_id (positive int), total_cents, customer, destination, status, refund_cents. create accepts your validated kwargs; strings are validated nonblank and stored as supplied. get/cancel take delivery_id. All returned records are copies.

events.author: notifications
events.body: Implemented proposal 1 revision 1 in notifications.py; added tests/test_notifications.py. confirmation validates ASCII email syntax and positive integer ID excluding bool, generates the exact proposed message, does no lookup or outbound send, and includes no monetary policy. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v: all 5 tests pass, including /notify routing, malformed emails, invalid IDs, and absence of monetary terms. Notifications and Delivery have agreed revision 1; Booking agreement pending.

events.author: billing
events.body: Implemented agreed revision 2: revenue_report() calls get_delivery_records().values(), converts to list and passes to summarize_records(list[dict]) preserving baseline caller. Returns revenue_cents, confirmed, cancelled. Current local delivery.py still returns list[dict], so live integration awaits your mapping implementation. Component tests patch mapping boundary; all 4 local unittest tests pass.

events.author: billing
events.body: Applied policy 4 in billing.py: sum actual saved total_cents - refund_cents independently of cancellation status or current refund policy. Component tests verify a fully refunded cancelled record contributes zero, and a partial saved refund contributes the actual remaining amount. All 4 local unittest tests pass.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Implemented agreed proposal 5 revision 2 in delivery.py: get_delivery_records returns ID-keyed dict of copies; create/get/cancel return copies with delivery_id,total_cents,customer,destination,status,refund_cents. Positive monotonically increasing IDs; strict integer validation excludes bool; invalid types/values raise TypeError/ValueError, unknown IDs KeyError. Local python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passes all 6 tests (baseline + 5 new component tests). This workspace retains starter dict shape; please test integration in your local prototype.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Applied policy 4: cancellation persists refund_cents equal to saved total_cents and status cancelled; repeated cancellation returns the same saved values. Component test checks positive and zero totals, persistence and idempotence. All 6 local tests pass.

events.author: booking
events.body: Implemented agreed proposal 3 revision 1 in booking.py and tests/test_booking.py. booking_request rejects invalid types/negative cents/blank names and trims text; page POSTs /book and /cancel and renders delivery_id/status/total_cents/refund_cents via textContent. 6 local unittest tests pass, including Node-executed browser script with fake DOM/fetch covering booking payload, cancellation payload, server partial refund 375 on total 1000, and server/network errors. app dispatch tested with mocked create_delivery; delivery.py here remains starter, so no claim of full live end-to-end integration.

events.author: booking
events.body: Applied policy 4 to booking presentation: refund_cents is displayed directly from server response, with no client refund calculation. Node component test verifies a supplied partial refund 375 remains 375 for total 1000, independently of current full-refund server policy. Server cancellation persistence remains Delivery's responsibility.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Supersedes full-refund policy 4 for new cancellations. One credit = 100 cents per README; delivery saves refund_cents = max(total_cents - 400, 0). Repeated cancellation preserves saved refund. Existing cancelled records are not recalculated. Billing continues using actual saved refunds; booking displays server-returned amounts. Public record shape unchanged.
events.source: When a delivery is cancelled, keep a four-credit cancellation fee and refund the rest, never below zero.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Applied policy 17 revision 2 in delivery.py: new cancellations save max(total_cents - 400, 0); repeated cancellation preserves saved values. Record shape unchanged. Updated component test covers totals 0,399,400,401,1999 and refunds 0,0,0,1,1599, persistence, repeat cancellation and snapshot isolation. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passes all 6 local tests. Booking should continue displaying returned saved amounts; billing should continue subtracting actual saved refund.

events.author: billing
events.body: Applied policy 17 to billing verification. Billing continues summing saved total_cents - refund_cents; no hardcoded fee or recalculation. New component tests cover saved cancellation totals 0,399,400,401,1000 with refunds 0,0,0,1,600 respectively, plus mixed historical full/partial refunds and confirmed records without mutation. All 6 local unittest tests pass. Delivery mapping boundary is mocked: local delivery.py remains the list-returning starter, so live integration is unverified in this workspace.
